medications.interpretation_notes: RHR +1-5 bpm and lower HRV expected (class effect) - use post-initiation baseline (reset at each dose step) and require a second signal before flagging; appetite suppressed - protein >= T.glp1.protein_floor_g_per_kg daily, zero-intake days may be real under-eating; weight loss expected - flag only rate > T.glp1.weight_loss_rate_flag_pct_per_week or lean-mass share > T.glp1.lean_mass_share_of_loss_flag_pct; delayed gastric emptying - last solid meal >= T.glp1.pre_run_meal_gap_hours_min h pre-run; hydration and heat caution; keep >= 1 strength session/week; injection Wednesdays - side-effect window Thu-Sat, place long run / harder work Sun-Tue

recommendations.text: Resume nutrition logging immediately. 16+ consecutive zero-intake days on a GLP-1 agonist is a genuine fuelling risk — appetite suppression can cause real under-eating, not just under-logging. Protein floor 1.6 g/kg (≥162 g/day at 101 kg) on every day, target 2.0 g/kg on training days. Even if intake feels low, LOG IT: the data is the only way to distinguish 'eating less on Wegovy (expected)' from 'eating dangerously little (RED-S territory)'. Prioritise protein-dense, low-volume, low-fat foods (semaglutide slows gastric emptying and worsens fat tolerance).
